content.title: Koppal Court Sentences Man to Life Imprisonment for Murdering Wife
content.caption: Koppal District Court sentences a man to life imprisonment for murdering his wife.

slides.heading: Koppal District Court Sentences
slides.text: Koppal District Court sentences a man to life imprisonment for murdering his wife.
slides.image_search_query: Koppal District Court, murder, wife India

slides.heading: Case Details
slides.text: The man, Manjunath, was found guilty of murdering his wife, Manjula, five years ago.

slides.heading: Conviction and Sentence
slides.text: The Principal District and Sessions Judge Latha Kumari M. awarded Manjunath life imprisonment and imposed a fine of ₹2 lakh.
